label: retailer sweep Retailer E
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The site showed a maintenance page instead of the shop to the automated browser. Not tested.

reclassified.why: the bot-check detector did not look inside iframes or recognise maintenance pages when this run started; fixed afterwards

events.thought: The shop shows only a maintenance page with no products, cart or search, so I cannot proceed.

findings.problem: The whole page is a maintenance notice. There is no navigation, search, product link or cart, so no purchase path exists. The only interactive element is the Help Center link, which leaves the shopping flow.
The region list (U.S. & Canada, Europe, Japan) is exposed as plain list items with no link role or name, so an agent cannot tell whether they are choices it can click or just text.
The brand name is plain text, not a link or banner landmark, and there are empty paragraph nodes with no content. Nothing in the tree gives a way back to a store home page.
The page title still reads as the normal shop title instead of saying maintenance, so the state is only clear from the h1 and body text. Re-reading at steps 2 and 3 showed no change.
